added.summary: `Touch.base`, `Touch.knob`, `Touch.pad`, `Touch.button` (`.primary`), `Touch.charge` (`.ready`), `Touch.icon`, `Touch.actions` and `Touch.bar`: a theme sizes and dresses the touch stick, d-pad, action buttons, their charge ring and the cluster's spacing. A full charge on an enabled button glows and breathes.

`Pips.units`, `Pips.pip`, `Pips.fill` (`.success`, `.warn`, `.info`, `.primary`), `Pips.label` and `Counter.value`; Pips takes a `class`. The screens guide has a recipe that builds a weapon level from Pips, Counter and HudBar.

fixed.summary: The weapon keeps a gap from both names and gives way first on a narrow row, so names no longer run into it (`Feed.weapon`).
`tone` colours the full units as documented; they were always a life's red.
Type-checks under `exactOptionalPropertyTypes`, which the game template sets; importing the components index failed in a game's `og check`.
